expect.outcome: Run a bounded evidence-index trial with a complete cost and acceptance account.

authority.owner: Incident reviewer for the handoff; trial owner for keep/revise/retire.
authority.source: Approved teaching trial agreement in Section 12.1; accounting rule in Sections 12.5–12.7.

acceptance: Index preserves source links and gaps; every attempt counted; accepted outcome is a distinct reviewed handoff; missing observations remain missing.

stop_conditions: Required authority or source evidence is missing.
Declared budget is spent or a proposed edit crosses protected scope.

checks.expected: Index fidelity review; attempt/outcome reconciliation; cost recalculation and sensitivity; human learning observations only if actually collected.

decide.owner: Incident reviewer for the handoff; trial owner for keep/revise/retire.
decide.object: The index and trial decision, not an operational repair or measured learning claim.
